text:
maya: hey team :wave: starting oncall next week — quick questions: who is my buddy, how do i run the pager test, and where are the 'first-week' runbooks? trying to finish setup before rotation. TL;DR: PagerDuty, runbook access, and a practice sim would be great.
jordan: welcome :tada: i'm your buddy for week 1. add me on PD (jordan@redwood.com). i'll schedule a shadow shift and pair with you for the first two incidents.
chris: added maya to the oncall calendar and shadow rota. for a basic pager test, run this from your laptop (on VPN):
```
curl -X POST https://ops-api.redwood.internal/pager/test -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_TOKEN' -d '{"user":"maya"}'
```
OpsBot will acknowledge the test. if you see 403 check VPN/SSO or missing role.
maya: ran the curl and got 403 — SSO shows me logged in though.
samir: 403 usually means the service role isn't granted. jordan, can you add maya to the "oncall-test" IAM role? also check `~/.redwood/credentials` for an id_token.
jordan: done — added maya to oncall-test and pushed a sync. maya, try curl again.
opsbot: OpsBot: Received pager test request from maya. Sim queued; delivering alert in ~30s.
maya: ok now i get 200 OK and i just got a push on my phone: "TEST ALERT — do not ack". pager app shows source: ops-sim.
chris: perfect. next: live shadow sim tomorrow 10:00am PT. join Zoom: https://zoom.redwood.com/j/123456789. we'll walk through triage, runbook lookup, and escalation paths. agenda + checklist here: https://docs.redwood.com/runbooks/oncall/new-hire-shadow
maya: thanks. one more Q — who do i escalate infra / db issues to? what's expected ack time for a P1?
jordan: infra escalate to @samir, db to @chris. expected ack: 5m during business hours for P1, escalate to eng-sre after 10m if no ack. runbook excerpt: ```Escalation: P1 -> primary pager -> 5m ack -> 10m escalate to eng-sre -> 20m exec notify```
samir: i'll be available for your first two shadows. enable SMS fallback in PD contact methods and confirm your phone number in profile. also check that your MFA device is registered.
opsbot: OpsBot: Pager test log: 1822004510 - Delivered to maya via push; status: delivered; ack: none.
maya: really appreciate everyone — i'm set for the curl test and i'll be on the zoom tomorrow. less nervous now :thumbsup:
